title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Bentley University
description: Bentley students balance rigorous business studies with a late-night food scene that spans on-campus staples and the diverse 'Restaurant Row' of Moody Street.

cards.title: Harry's Pub
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Late Night Hub
cards.notes: Visit the Student Center for bar-style food starting at 8:00 PM. It is the primary on-campus destination for students after the main dining hall closes.
cards.short_summary: The central on-campus spot for late-night food and socializing in the Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Harry's Pub offers food service nightly starting at 8:00 PM, with regular hours until 12:45 AM Sunday-Thursday and 1:45 AM Friday-Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:45 AM (Sun-Thu) and 1:45 AM (Fri-Sat) during the academic year.

cards.title: Margaritas Mexican Restaurant
cards.subtitle: Moody Street Late Night Fiesta
cards.notes: Head to Moody Street for late-night appetizers and a lively atmosphere. It is a popular off-campus choice for students using the Falcon Flyer shuttle.
cards.short_summary: A staple of Waltham's Restaurant Row offering late-night food and a dedicated 'Late Night Fiesta' menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Margaritas in Waltham is open until 12:00 AM on Tuesday-Wednesday and 1:00 AM Thursday-Saturday, with a late-night menu available from 9:00 PM to close.
cards.source_title: Margaritas Mexican Restaurant in Waltham MA
cards.access_notes: Kitchen and bar open until 1:00 AM on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.

cards.title: In A Pickle Restaurant
cards.subtitle: Brunch and Late Night Smash Burgers
cards.notes: Try the 'Night Menu' featuring smash burgers and wings. This Moody Street favorite is known for creative comfort food and large portions.
cards.short_summary: A famous Waltham eatery that extends its creative menu into the late evening with a dedicated night selection.
cards.evidence_claim: In A Pickle offers a 'Night Menu' served from 3:00 PM to 10:00 PM Wednesday through Saturday, including wings and smash burgers.
cards.source_title: In A Pickle Restaurant - Contact Us
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM Wednesday through Saturday.

cards.title: Shopper's Café
cards.subtitle: Neighborhood Pub with Late Kitchen
cards.notes: Grab a burger or steak tips at this family-owned spot. The kitchen stays open later than many other local restaurants on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing Waltham neighborhood pub known for its late-night kitchen and sports-friendly atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Shopper's Café kitchen is open until 11:00 PM Thursday through Saturday, with the bar remaining open until 1:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Kitchen open until 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday nights.

cards.title: Bistro 781
cards.subtitle: Elevated Late Night Dining
cards.notes: Enjoy a more upscale late-night meal on Moody Street. The name pays homage to the local area code and serves as a community gathering point.
cards.short_summary: An elevated American bistro on Moody Street that keeps its kitchen open until 11:00 PM on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Bistro 781 serves dinner until 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday, with the bar closing later.
cards.access_notes: Dinner service available until 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: Tessie's Bar & Kitchen
cards.subtitle: Craft Burgers on Main Street
cards.notes: Located on Main Street, this spot is known for creative burgers and a kitchen that serves until 11:00 PM on busy weekend nights.
cards.short_summary: A popular local spot for craft burgers and salads with extended kitchen hours on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Tessie's Bar & Kitchen in Waltham keeps its kitchen open until 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Kitchen open until 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday nights.

cards.title: Pini's Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: Late Night Pizza Delivery
cards.notes: A go-to for pizza delivery or pickup. While not open past midnight, it remains a consistent evening option for students in dorms.
cards.short_summary: A local favorite for thin-crust pizza and Italian subs, frequently ordered by the Bentley community.
cards.evidence_claim: Pini's Pizzeria in Waltham is open until 9:00 PM daily, serving as a reliable evening meal option.
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM daily for pickup and delivery.

cards.title: Bentley University Library
cards.subtitle: Midnight Study Sessions
cards.notes: The library provides a quiet space for late-night academic work, with hours extending to midnight for much of the week.
cards.short_summary: The primary academic hub for late-night study, offering extended hours during the semester.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bentley University Library is open until 12:00 AM Sunday through Thursday during the academic trimester.
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM Sunday-Thursday; hours may extend to 24/7 during final exams.

cards.title: Waltham Falcon Flyer
cards.subtitle: The Late Night Connection
cards.notes: Use the university shuttle to reach Moody Street restaurants. It is the essential link between campus and Waltham's dining scene.
cards.short_summary: The university's shuttle service that connects students to off-campus dining and transportation hubs late into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: The Falcon Flyer shuttle operates until 11:38 PM on Fridays and 11:47 PM on Saturdays, with stops at Moody Street.
cards.source_title: Shuttle Routes and Schedules - Bentley University
cards.access_notes: Operates until approximately 11:45 PM on weekends during the academic year.

cards.title: The Nest
cards.subtitle: Retail Dining Option
cards.notes: Located in the Student Center, this retail spot offers meal trade options and quick bites for students studying late.
cards.short_summary: A retail dining location on campus providing flexible meal options beyond the traditional dining hall hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nest is listed as a designated retail location for meal trades and is located within the Student Center hub.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by semester; typically open for evening retail service.
